newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian textile export rise 10.48 pct in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian textile export rise 10.48 pct in 1996.

text.p: Industry and Trade Minister Tunky Ariwibowo said on Friday Indonesia's exports of textiles and textile-related products rose 10.48 percent to $6.85 billion in 1996.

"The management of our textile exports is improving. Exports of our textiles and textile-related products rose to $6.85 billion in 1996 from $6.2 billion in 1995," he told reporters after meeting President Suharto.
He said the government would continue to encouarge businessmen to increase textile exports in the coming year.
The Indonesian Textile Association said on January 13 Indonesia's textile and textile-related products were expected to rise to more than $7 billion in 1997.
It added that Indonesia's textiles and textile products faced strong competition from abraod, with many buyers turning to countries such as Bangladesh, Vietnam and Turkey for their supplies.
